iti91:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti91:2.2: abhisāpo’yaṃ bhikkhave lokasmiṃ piṇḍolo vicarasi pattapāṇīti.
iti91:2.3: tañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā atthavasaṃ paṭicca,
iti91:2.4: neva rājābhinītā na corābhinītā na iṇaṭṭā na bhayaṭṭā na ājīvikāpakatā.
iti91:2.5: api ca kho otiṇṇamhā jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhābhikiṇṇā dukkhaparetā
iti91:2.6: appevanāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethāti.
iti91:2.8: hoti abhijjhālu kāmesu tibbasārāgo byāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo, muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo.
iti91:2.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave chavālātaṃ ubhato padittaṃ majjhegūthagataṃ neva gāme kaṭṭhatthaṃ pharati na araññe,
iti91:2.10: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi gihibhogā ca parihīno sāmaññatthañca na paripūretī’ti.
iti91:6.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
